name: Planning Table
description: Editable planning table with writeback to the SAC model and linked dimension input controls.

planningEnabled.description: Allow editing measure cells and writing values back to the model

autoSubmit.description: Submit each edited cell to the model immediately

showInputControls.description: Show the dimension filter dropdowns above the table

inputControlDimensions.description: Comma separated dimension ids used as linked input controls. Empty = all bound dimensions.

linkedAnalysisEnabled.description: Publish input control selections as filters to linked widgets

rowInputControls.description: Render a dimension dropdown inside every table row so each row can be re-pointed to another member

rowInputControlDimensions.description: Comma separated dimension ids shown as per-row dropdowns. Empty = all bound dimensions.

submitPlanningData.description: Submit all pending edited cells to the planning model

getPendingChanges.description: Returns the pending edited cells as a JSON string

getSelectedMembers.description: Returns the current input control selection as a JSON string

onValueChange.description: Fired when a measure cell value is changed by the user

onDataSubmitted.description: Fired after edited values were written back to the model

onSubmitError.description: Fired when writeback to the model failed

onInputControlChange.description: Fired when an input control (dimension) selection changes

onRowInputControlChange.description: Fired when a per-row dimension dropdown selection changes

onCellSelect.description: Fired when a cell is selected
